reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal is 3 short paragraphs proposing to replace MNDE burn mechanism with buy-and-distribute. Protocol revenue buys MNDE (possibly weekly), VeMNDE holders claim proportional rewards. The note explicitly states the proposal lacks formal MIP sections and key specifics.
reasoning_trace.inference: Extremely brief proposal with major tokenomics implications but minimal detail. High likelihood of multiple red flags for vagueness, missing milestones, and undefined authority structures.

reasoning_trace.observation: Author is berkantsc. VeMNDE holders are repeatedly mentioned as beneficiaries. No other parties named - no implementation team, no multisig, no reviewers.
reasoning_trace.inference: Only two clear stakeholders: proposer and VeMNDE holders as affected group. Absence of implementation authority is notable.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal states 'Protocol revenue will buy back MNDE' but provides no specific amounts, percentages, or caps. The note confirms 'exact buyback budget' is not included.
reasoning_trace.inference: Treasury outflow (protocol revenue spent on buybacks and distributed) but unquantifiable. This triggers unbounded_spend red flag. Amount remains null due to zero specification.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal describes buyback execution and distribution mechanism but never specifies who controls the buyback wallet, who executes purchases, or who implements the claim system. No multisig cited, no existing authority referenced.
reasoning_trace.inference: Implementation requires substantial execution authority (buyback wallet control, market operations, claim system admin) but proposal provides zero specification of who holds these permissions. This is undefined authority for a critical treasury function - backdoor_permission HIGH severity.

reasoning_trace.observation: Rationale states this will 'significantly bring more value to MNDE ecosystem' with no metrics, baselines, or measurement criteria. No implementation timeline, no staged rollout, no success checkpoints.
reasoning_trace.inference: Completely non-measurable KPI and zero milestone structure. Emit vague_kpi and missing_milestone red flags.

reasoning_trace.observation: Mechanism switches from burn (deflationary - removes tokens from supply) to distribute (neutral to inflationary - recirculates tokens). Skill mandates token_dilution flag for 'any direction' of supply trajectory change including 'paused emissions, burns, buybacks'.
reasoning_trace.inference: Clear token_dilution trigger - stops burns and starts distributions. Magnitude unknown due to unspecified budget, but this is a fundamental tokenomics change affecting all future protocol revenue allocation. Medium severity due to unknown magnitude but systematic impact.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal has 6+ critical gaps: budget, execution authority, timeline, VeMNDE formula, transition plan, claim mechanics.
reasoning_trace.inference: Delegate needs answers on execution authority (who controls buyback wallet), budget bounds (what percentage of protocol revenue), timeline, and technical implementation before this is voteable.
